method: Each record was read from the official PSX Data Portal company page (dps.psx.com.pk/company/<TICKER>). KSE-30 membership was read from https://dps.psx.com.pk/indices/KSE30 on the same day. 'XD' shown next to some symbols on PSX is an ex-dividend status marker, not part of the ticker. Only the official PSX sector is recorded; company-specific segments and exposures are Phase 4 work and require evidence.
